mechanism: Additive hypotensive effects from valsartan combined with anticholinergic-induced sympathomimetic activity and potential fluid retention from oxybutynin; both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism with minor CYP3A4 involvement.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; educate patient on orthostatic precautions; assess renal function periodically as both drugs affect fluid balance and valsartan efficacy depends on adequate renal perfusion.
